name: Crazy Cards
hook: Match the color or number. Empty your hand first.
how: Play a card that matches the top card by color or number, or a wild. Skip, reverse, +2 and wild +4 change the turn. No match? Draw one. First to empty their hand wins the round.
controls: Click or tap a card, tap the deck to draw
uses: Your hand is sealed so only you can read it (the host deals, so it can too).
The host's browser shuffles, deals and checks every card; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots fill empty seats and take over for anyone who leaves.
Rounds won, shown after every round.
ideas: Add a wild card that swaps hands
Add a points mode over five rounds
